mentions.name: Single-file self-hosting RISC-V operating system
mentions.description: This operating system is written entirely in one text file, which contains in order a readme, RISC-V assembly boot code, and the rest of the system. The initial boot code is compiled with a basic RISC-V assembler and concatenated with the text file itself; when run, the boot code compiles the rest of the file, including higher-level language compilers that the rest of the system is written in. The goal is to create something from as little as possible, needing only a very basic RISC-V assembler and a computer or emulator to get started.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just started building an operating system that will be written entirely in one text file.
This text file includes in order: a readme, a RISC-V assembly boot code, then the rest.
